title: IDPGitOps data model
description: Canonical entity definitions, reconstructed from the code that defines them. Every $defs entry carries the path:line it was derived from; field names and casing are the running system's, not a style guide's. This repository has no database: each entity's system of record is a committed file, a cluster object, a vault or a process boundary. Nothing else in the hub may define a field.

service_request.description: Validated intake for one new service. Owned by: onboarding intake. Introduced by: F-001. Derived from the frozen dataclass and its __post_init__ validation [D: tools/service_seed/jira_intake.py:48].

issue_key.description: Tracker key; required and non-empty [D: tools/service_seed/jira_intake.py:64].

slo_class.description: Membership enforced [D: tools/service_seed/jira_intake.py:29]; absent from the payload resolves to silver [D: tools/service_seed/jira_intake.py:159].

summary.description: Falls back to the issue key when the payload has none [D: tools/service_seed/jira_intake.py:181].

description.description: Rich text flattened to plain text [D: tools/service_seed/jira_intake.py:95].

cluster_entry.description: One cluster in the committed topology catalogue. Owned by: cluster registry. Introduced by: F-001 (first consumer); catalogued by F-003. System of record: gitops/clusters/registry.yaml, schema-enforced [D: gitops/clusters/registry.schema.json:1] and typed on load [D: tools/service_seed/cli.py:43].

name.description: Catalogue key; the loader rejects an entry whose aks_name differs [D: tools/service_seed/cli.py:198].

subscription_id.description: Azure subscription. Committed values are placeholders [D: gitops/clusters/registry.yaml:29].

region_abbrev.description: Must match the canonical region map or the Terraform precondition fails [D: terraform/invariants.tf:95].

slo_profile.description: Analysis thresholds for one availability tier. Owned by: release profiles. Introduced by: F-001. System of record: tools/service_seed/profiles/slo.yaml [D: tools/service_seed/profiles/slo.yaml:14]. On disk the tier is the mapping key; slo_class materialises that key so a record can stand alone.

rollout_profile.description: Canary step sequence for one availability tier. Owned by: release profiles. Introduced by: F-001. System of record: tools/service_seed/profiles/rollout.yaml [D: tools/service_seed/profiles/rollout.yaml:12]. Steps are joined verbatim into the rendered strategy.

gitops_manifest_file.description: One rendered file in a service's scaffold, addressed by repository-relative path. Owned by: onboarding render. Introduced by: F-001. Derived from the path keys the renderer returns [D: tools/service_seed/service_template.py:251]. The rendered bytes are template output and are not modelled.

tier.description: The partition key for the two change sets [D: tools/service_seed/cli.py:381].

env.description: Overlay only; the three environments are fixed [D: tools/service_seed/service_template.py:53].

gitops_pull_request.description: A proposal opened against the platform GitOps repository. Owned by: onboarding git layer. Introduced by: F-001. Derived from the pull-request payload [D: tools/service_seed/gitops_pr.py:63] and the two call sites that compose it [D: tools/service_seed/cli.py:384].

repo_slug.description: Derived from the remote URL's last segment, .git stripped [D: tools/service_seed/gitops_pr.py:163].

description.description: Names the request key and the tier [D: tools/service_seed/cli.py:389].

path_root.description: apps at both call sites [D: tools/service_seed/cli.py:390].

seed_result.description: Machine-readable outcome of one onboarding run, printed as a single JSON line. Owned by: onboarding wiring. Introduced by: F-001. Not persisted. Keys are camelCase because that is how the run emits them [D: tools/service_seed/cli.py:408].

mgmt_leader_status.description: One management cluster's locally readable statement of what it currently is. Owned by: lease controller (write), scaling reconciler and operators (read). Introduced by: F-002. System of record: a ConfigMap in the cluster it describes, upserted wholesale [D: tools/mgmt-plane-lock/internal/kube/status.go:35].

holderIdentity.description: Written from the same cluster name [D: tools/mgmt-plane-lock/internal/kube/status.go:37].

leadershipStatus.description: The reader accepts only these two [D: tools/mgmt-plane-lock/internal/scaling/scaling.go:91].

lastObservedAt.description: RFC 3339 UTC, written at upsert time [D: tools/mgmt-plane-lock/internal/kube/status.go:42].

lease_controller_config.description: Validated startup contract of the lease controller. Owned by: lease controller. Introduced by: F-002. System of record: the process environment [D: tools/mgmt-plane-lock/internal/config/config.go:22]. Bounds are part of the model because an out-of-bounds value refuses startup rather than being corrected [D: tools/mgmt-plane-lock/internal/config/config.go:79].

renew_interval_seconds.description: Default 15 [D: tools/mgmt-plane-lock/internal/config/config.go:17]; must be positive and strictly shorter than the term [D: tools/mgmt-plane-lock/internal/config/config.go:85].

controller_workload.description: One platform controller the scaling reconciler governs, with the replica count each leadership state implies. Owned by: scaling reconciler. Introduced by: F-002. System of record: the declared list compiled into the reconciler [D: tools/mgmt-plane-lock/internal/scaling/scaling.go:34].

checkov_baseline_finding.description: One suppressed supply-chain finding, with the metadata that keeps a suppression reviewable. Owned by: platform invariant gates. Introduced by: F-003. System of record: .checkov.baseline, whose _schema header names the required fields [D: .checkov.baseline:6] and whose validator reads that header rather than hardcoding them [D: scripts/validate-checkov-baseline.py:63].

owner.description: Team or handle accountable for re-evaluation [D: docs/checkov-baseline-metadata-schema.md:12].

expiry.description: Date after which the suppression fails the PR [D: docs/checkov-baseline-metadata-schema.md:13].

tool_version_pin.description: One pinned toolchain version. Owned by: platform invariant gates. Introduced by: F-003. System of record: .tool-versions, which is the only file allowed to declare these [D: .tool-versions:11]; a second declaration fails CI [D: scripts/validate-tool-version-singleton.py:1].

note.description: Trailing comment on the line; advisory, not a pin [D: .tool-versions:11].

akv_secret_entry.description: One catalogued Key Vault secret and who owns its write path. Owned by: secret lifecycle. Introduced by: F-004. System of record: the two Terraform catalogues — mode terraform_managed [D: terraform/locals.tf:41] and mode referenced_only [D: terraform/locals.tf:67].

name.description: Catalogue key; the secret's name in the vault.

mode.description: terraform_managed entries must also exist as an azurerm_key_vault_secret [D: terraform/locals.tf:38]; referenced_only entries are written elsewhere [D: terraform/locals.tf:64].

akv_secret_version.description: The projection a vault read returns. Owned by: secret lifecycle. Introduced by: F-004. Derived from the Get projection [D: tools/mgmt-plane-lock/internal/akvwriter/akvwriter.go:65]. The value field exists in the projection and is deliberately absent from every fixture.

updated_at.description: Version timestamp, used to compute token age [D: tools/mgmt-plane-lock/internal/rotation/rotation.go:157].

enabled.description: Superseded versions are disabled rather than deleted [D: tools/mgmt-plane-lock/internal/akvwriter/akvwriter_test.go:308].

secret_write.description: One write through the single vault write path. Owned by: secret lifecycle. Introduced by: F-004. Derived from the Put surface and its Strategy enum [D: tools/mgmt-plane-lock/internal/akvwriter/akvwriter.go:76].

strategy.description: Overwrite is the default and refuses to revive a soft-deleted secret [D: tools/mgmt-plane-lock/internal/akvwriter/akvwriter.go:50].

outcome.description: Typed sentinels callers test with errors.Is [D: tools/mgmt-plane-lock/internal/akvwriter/akvwriter.go:58].
